create_DPPOTrainer: create a DPPOTrainer instance with a model, reward functions, and DPPOConfig for divergence proximal policy optimization
run_DPPOTrainer_train: run the DPPOTrainer training loop to fine-tune a language model using divergence-based trust regions
compute_DPPOTrainer_divergence_mask: compute a per-token trust-region mask based on binary_tv, binary_kl, topk_tv, or topk_kl divergence type
compute_DPPOTrainer_loss: compute the DPPO policy loss with KL regularization and divergence masking over a batch of completions
generate_DPPOTrainer_completions: generate model completions with tool call support and extract per-token logprobs for policy optimization
